Class LinkageGraphBuilder

java.lang.Object
algorithms.LinkageGraphBuilder
public class LinkageGraphBuilder extends Object
Builds in-sway weighted linkage graphs from a directed k-nearest-neighbor digraph.

Input is a SparseIntDirectedWeightedGraph on vertices 0,1,...,n-1. Even if the original similarity relation is symmetric, nearest-neighbor relations are generally directed, so directed input storage is required.

Say z is a friend of x if z is among x's k-nearest outgoing neighbors.

The workflow is: identify mutual-friend pairs, compute in-sway for each pair, build an undirected linkage graph weighted by in-sway, and then analyze thresholded subgraphs and connected components.

For each mutual pair {x,z}, in-sway is the number of eligible 2-simplices where edge xz is the source edge in the local ordering.

Explicit rank arrays are unnecessary; comparisons are made directly from outgoing edge weights.

The class can also find threshold values of in-sway to control maximum connected-component size.

Tested via TestLinkageGraphBuilder on a variety of directed graphs.

Author:
R. W. R. Darling

    • LinkageGraphBuilder

      public LinkageGraphBuilder(boolean higherWeightMoreSimilar)
      Creates a linkage-graph builder.

      The higherWeightMoreSimilar flag controls all neighbor comparisons in methods such as moreSimilarTo(int, int, int).

      Parameters:
      higherWeightMoreSimilar - true if the higher of two weights of outgoing edges from vertex x points to vertex more similar to vertex x.

    • unionFindUpToClusterThreshold

      public int unionFindUpToClusterThreshold(int m)
      Finds the smallest in-sway threshold whose retained-link graph has maximum component size at most m.

      Let L_t be the linkage graph containing edges with in-sway at least t. This method returns the smallest threshold t such that the largest component of L_t has size no greater than m.

      Parameters:
      m - maximum acceptable size of a cluster
      Returns:
      minimum value of t so that links with in-sway at least t form a graph whose largest connected component is not more than m

    • buildGraphInswayNotLessThan

      public void buildGraphInswayNotLessThan(int inSwayLowerBound)
      Builds the linkage subgraph containing all links with in-sway at least inSwayLowerBound.

      Parameters:
      inSwayLowerBound - is minimum value of in-sway for links in the linkageSubgraph.

    • buildSubCriticalGraph

      public void buildSubCriticalGraph()
      Builds the subcritical linkage graph.

      Call buildLinkageGraph() first. This method restricts the linkage graph to edges whose in-sway exceeds critical value, i.e. fewer links than object.

      public int detectComponentsOf(org.jgrapht.opt.graph.sparse.SparseIntUndirectedWeightedGraph subGraph)

      Returns:
      size of largest component.
